title: Qatar Calls for Ceasefire, UAE Backs Government as Fighting Spreads Beyond Tigray
detail: Qatar urged an immediate ceasefire citing threats to Ethiopia's unity and sovereignty, while the UAE declared full solidarity with the government. Fighting has displaced roughly 150,000 people across Tigray, Amhara and Afar after Tigrayan forces seized the Mekelle, Axum and Shire airports, prompting Ethiopian Airlines suspensions. Ethiopia's military accused Eritrea, Sudan and Egypt of backing opposition forces; Sudan and Egypt denied involvement. UN Secretary-General Guterres voiced grave concern and called for humanitarian access. Over 420 wounded were treated in Korem and Alamata hospitals between Sep 22-25.

media.caption: Regional reactions to the escalating fighting in northern Ethiopia
